name: What counts as interior storm damage that can be repaired?

mainEntity.name: What counts as interior storm damage that can be repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior storm damage repair usually covers water intrusion from roof, window, siding, or structural failures, plus damage to ceilings, drywall, insulation, flooring, trim, and contents. A technician should inspect both visible damage and hidden moisture so the full scope is identified before repairs begin.
acceptedAnswer.description: Anything inside the home damaged by storm-driven water or impact—like ceilings, drywall, flooring, insulation, and trim—can usually be included if it’s documented and accessible.
